function: Cascaded-channel estimation for an IRS-assisted multiuser uplink: denoising CNN (ADDnet) refines LS estimates, trained without ground-truth channels on DCGAN-augmented data (pp. 1, 5-7).
system: BS with 8 antennas, reflecting IRS with 32 passive elements, 5 single-antenna users, TDD uplink pilots with DFT reflection patterns; frequency band not stated (pp. 4-5, 8).
method: Supervised denoising CNN (ADDnet, FFDnet-based residual blocks) trained on labels formed as LS estimate minus captured noise; DCGAN generates extra training samples; Adam, EMSE loss (pp. 6-8).
data_channel: Simulated Rician (IRS-BS factor 10) and Rayleigh fading with path loss; 8000 sets from varied user positions, 6000 for training and the rest for testing (p. 8).
test_conditions: Train: simulated user positions. Test: held-out sets and new test sets with direct or cascaded channel parameters shifted by discrepancy epsilon; NMSE versus 5-10 users (pp. 8-11).
baselines: Non-learned: LS, alternating LS (ALS). Learned: CDRN [37], CV-DnCNN [43], InterpResNet [38], SSL [11], each trained on original and on mixed data (pp. 8-9).
metrics: NMSE versus transmit SNR, epochs, number of users and channel discrepancy; training epochs saved; FLOPs and parameter count (pp. 9-11).
complexity: ADDnet 7.31x10^10 FLOPs and 3.74x10^8 parameters, the highest of the compared networks (Table III, p. 10).
q1_support: p. 8: "Rician fading model is adopted to quantify the small-scale fading on all channels". Missing: custom simulator with its own path-loss exponents; no 3GPP model, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 11: "The difference between the parameters of these testing and training sets is represented by the normalized discrepancy"; the test sets are built by modifying the direct and cascaded channel parameters (Figs. 12 and 13).
q3_support: p. 8: "model-driven channel estimation schemes LS [12] and alternating LS (ALS) [42], as well as the data-driven channel estimation schemes CDRN [37]", with CV-DnCNN [43], InterpResNet [38] and SSL [11] also compared on NMSE (Fig. 7, p. 9).
q4_support: p. 10: "quantified by measuring the floating-point operations (FLOPs) and total parameters used in the neural network inferences"; Table III lists both for ADDnet and the baselines.
q5_support: p. 8: "this paper simulates user position distribution" to generate its own data. Missing: no code or data link, public dataset or measured data; p. 4 says other works have not revealed their datasets, yet none is released here.
notes: Area 2, estimation of the IRS cascaded channel. Labels are LS estimates minus captured noise, not true channels (p. 6). q2 rests on the mismatch test of Figs. 12 and 13; the sweep over users in Fig. 11 does not say whether the model was retrained. Table I and Table III and Figs. 6 to 13 were checked on the page images.
